title: [PULSE-3339] Add the Schedule Builder Open Schedule button
description:
Linear: [PULSE-3339](https://linear.app/planera/issue/PULSE-3339/give-manny-a-new-complete-builder-button-to-end-the-flow)

Adds an **Open Schedule** button (`ScheduleBuilderFinishButton` Generative UI widget) that the Schedule Builder agent can put at the end of its final reply. Clicking it ends the builder flow and closes Manny, exactly like the header Exit after its confirmation, with no dialog.

Chat emits it as a `generative_ui` event with `component: "ScheduleBuilderFinishButton"` and `props: {}` when the agent calls `finish_schedule_build` (https://gitlab.com/planera.io/python/chat/-/merge_requests/1069). The webapp already wires `scheduleBuilderFlow.onEnd`.

- Shows only in builder mode on the latest reply, and never in PDF export.
- Disabled while the flow is starting, ending, or the builder session is responding.
- New `useEndScheduleBuilder` hook holds the end sequence, shared with the header Exit: end the flow, then close Manny, or show the "Unable to exit Schedule Builder Agent" toast on failure.
- Every stream and history request now advertises `ScheduleBuilderFinishButton` in `supportedWidgets`. Chat binds its tool only for clients that advertise the button, so an older client is never told about a button it cannot show.
- New automation ID `MANNY.CHAT.SCHEDULE_BUILDER.FINISH_BUTTON` (`manny-schedule-builder-finish-button`).

# Rollout

- Depends on chat: https://gitlab.com/planera.io/python/chat/-/merge_requests/1069.
- Followed by a webapp `@planera/manny` bump once this MR merges. The webapp needs no other change.
- Deploy order does not matter: each side does nothing new until the other is present.

# Testing

- Wrapper tests: hidden outside the builder, on older turns, and in PDF; disabled while starting, ending, or processing; a click ends the flow then closes Manny; a false result keeps Manny open; a rejection shows the error toast.
- Renderer test that `isLatestTurn` is forwarded (the PDF guard is tested in the wrapper test); `supportedWidgets`, stream body, and history query tests updated.
- After rebasing on `main`: `vitest run` (2354 tests), `tsc --noEmit`, and ESLint pass locally.
- End-to-end check (builder, ask to finish, select Open Schedule, project unlocks) not done yet.
